name: نرخ زنده
author: Ramin Hakimi

sections.description:
Nerkh Live is a professional WordPress plugin that lets you display live prices of gold, currency, coins and cryptocurrencies on your website.

The plugin retrieves real-time financial data from an API web service and automatically displays the rates on your site using a fully customizable sticky price bar.

Users can easily connect the plugin to the API by entering their API key obtained from the main website.

The plugin is completely free and compatible with WordPress and WooCommerce.

External Services

This plugin relies on the following external services:

Nerkh.IO Service

  • Service description: Nerkh.IO provides real-time financial market data (gold, currency, coins and cryptocurrencies) via a REST API.
  • Usage: Fetching live prices to display on the site through the shortcode widget and/or the sticky price bar.
  • Data sent and when:
    • The API key (for authentication) is sent with every request to api.nerkh.io.
    • A request is sent when an admin performs a “test” or “connect” action from the plugin settings page.
    • Automatic requests are sent at defined intervals (every 10, 30 or 60 minutes) via the WordPress cron to keep prices fresh.
    • No personal user or visitor data is sent.

Nerkh.IO Website (nerkh.io)

  • Service description: The main website of the Nerkh.IO service.
  • Usage: The “Nerkh ❤” (brand referral) link shown in the frontend sticky price bar links to https://nerkh.io. This is required by the API terms of use.
  • Data sent: No data from the plugin is sent to nerkh.io. The link is only displayed in the browser for the end user to click.
  • Provider: Nerkh.IO
  • Website: https://nerkh.io
  • Terms of use: https://nerkh.io/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://nerkh.io/privacy

Features

  • Live gold price display
  • Live currency price display
  • Live coin price display
  • Live cryptocurrency price display
  • Automatic price fetching from the API
  • Configurable update interval:
    • Every 10 minutes
    • Every 30 minutes
    • Every 60 minutes
  • Sticky price bar
  • Display at the top or bottom of the site
  • Full style customization
  • Background color setting
  • Light and dark mode support
  • Custom colors for each item
  • Price color setting
  • Separator color setting
  • Unit symbol color setting
  • Font size setting
  • Selectable display items
  • Support for 23+ financial items
  • API connection test
  • API response test
  • Easy installation and setup
  • WooCommerce compatible
  • Lightweight and optimized

Supported Items

The plugin supports various financial categories:

  • Gold
  • Coins
  • Dollar
  • Euro
  • Foreign currencies
  • Bitcoin
  • Tether
  • Cryptocurrencies
  • Digital currencies
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ folder.
  2. Activate the plugin from the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open the Nerkh Live settings page.
  4. Enter your API key.
  5. Save the settings.
  6. Configure the display style and update interval.
  7. Done! Live prices are now shown on your site.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

Yes. Nerkh Live is completely free for WordPress and WooCommerce users.

How do I connect the plugin to the API?

Get your API key from the main website and enter it in the plugin settings page.

Can I customize the design?

Yes. You can fully customize the colors, fonts, bar position and display style.

Can I choose which items to display?

Yes. You can select only the financial items you want to show on your site.

Does the plugin support automatic updates?

Yes. The plugin can update prices automatically every 10, 30 or 60 minutes.
